name: little-atlas
description: A gentle first adventure into country flags and geography.

scripts.dev: PORTLESS_PORT=1355 PORTLESS_HTTPS=0 portless little-atlas python3 serve.py

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name little-atlas --branch main
